title: How AI Social Responsibility Shapes Consumers’ Brand Advocacy
core_idea: Conceptualize AI social responsibility (AISR) into two dimensions—technical and institutional—develop and validate a measurement scale, and investigate how these AISR dimensions influence consumer brand advocacy via perceived AI credibility and perceived AI empathy, with AI literacy as a moderator, using mixed qualitative interviews, survey-based factor analyses, and experimental studies.
tldr: The study aims to define and measure two AISR dimensions (technical vs institutional) and test the mechanisms (credibility, empathy) and boundary condition (AI literacy) linking AISR to consumer brand advocacy using mixed methods.
